techStack: TypeScript ~6.0 targeting ES2023 ESM, executed via tsx (dev) / tsc (build)
Express v5 for HTTP routing, zod v4 for input validation
SQLite via better-sqlite3 v12 — synchronous, no ORM, raw SQL strings only
WHERE clauses built by pushing strings into conditions[] and values into params[], joined with ' AND ', then interpolated into a template literal SQL string
Parameterized queries use ? placeholders passed to db.prepare(...).all([...params, limit, offset])
Boolean columns (in_stock, featured) stored as INTEGER 0/1 in SQLite, mapped to JS booleans in rowToProduct
Test runner: Vitest v4 with globals mode; HTTP integration tests via supertest v7; pnpm as package manager
features: GET /products accepts filters: search (LIKE on name), category (equality), inStock (boolean), featured (currently JS-only), sort, page, limit
Response envelope: { data: Product[], total: number, page: number, limit: number, totalPages: number }
products.test.ts asserts: 15 total products unfiltered; 4 in electronics; 11 inStock; page=1&limit=5 → totalPages:3; limit clamped at 50
pagination.test.ts asserts: limit=10 with 15 products → totalPages:2 (Math.ceil test, currently failing); limit=5 → totalPages:3 (exact division, passes either way)
Auth middleware: Bearer token with even digit-sum → 200, odd → 401; GET /products requires auth
getFeaturedProducts() (separate function, line 100-111) correctly uses SQL WHERE with COALESCE on featured_overrides — this must not be touched
architecture: Layer stack: routes → controllers → services → db/client
products table columns: id, name, description, price, category, in_stock INTEGER, rating, stock, featured INTEGER, images TEXT (JSON), tags TEXT (JSON), created_at
featured_overrides table (migration 003): product_id, is_featured, set_at — used by getFeaturedProducts() via LEFT JOIN COALESCE, not by getProducts()
Bug 1 location: lines 56-58 — SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products (no WHERE); total always equals full table count
Bug 2 location: line 46 comment marks featured excluded from SQL; lines 67-69 apply JS filter post-pagination on already-sliced data[]
Bug 3 location: line 76 — Math.floor(total / limit) should be Math.ceil
edgeCases: featured=false: must produce SQL 'featured = 0', not 'featured = 1'; the JS filter correctly handled false but the SQL fix must branch on value
featured=undefined: the existing guard 'if (query.featured !== undefined)' must be preserved — only add to conditions when explicitly set
Multiple simultaneous filters (e.g. category + inStock + featured): conditions[] uses AND joining; adding featured to the array is consistent by construction — no extra handling needed
COUNT query must receive the same params array as the data query; once featured is in conditions/params, passing the full params to COUNT avoids a better-sqlite3 parameter-count mismatch
No active filters: where is empty string → COUNT(*) FROM products (correct, must not regress); total:15 assertions in products.test.ts must still pass
totalPages with total=0 (no matching products): Math.ceil(0/n) = 0 — correct, no special case needed
totalPages with exact division (15/5=3): Math.ceil(3)=3 = Math.floor(3) — no regression at even boundaries
totalPages with non-even division (15/10=1.5): Math.ceil → 2 (correct); Math.floor → 1 (wrong, current bug)
